Reduce padding, font sizes, gaps, and border radii on small viewports.
Header section now shrinks instead of being fixed. Stats pills, puzzle
panels, and action areas use compact sizing on mobile with sm: breakpoint
for larger screens. Outer container uses smaller padding on mobile.

Card grid now sizes based on both viewport width and height using CSS
min() in grid track definitions. Cards scale down in landscape to fit
within available space. Reduced padding and font sizes for compact
viewports. Won/restart sections use tighter spacing.
